goal: Keep the LLM main-chain memory promotion pipeline (task auto-complete -> complete_task result_json -> HarnessMemoryPromoter -> harness_memory.db) verifiably live, so completed work keeps producing long-term memory candidates instead of silently going dormant.

acceptance_criteria.description: A successful LLM response for an auto-complete workflow task must complete the task with a non-empty result summary and promote a task_outcome memory record with a memory_promoted task event.
An LLM error response must fail the task and must not promote any task_outcome memory, so provider failures never become long-term memory.
An insufficient-material response must move the task to blocked without promoting memory, preserving the material-intake gate.

Pre-stopped events entering the result-decorate stage must not be mis-attributed to the first on_decorating_result handler, and the core pipeline must not special-case plugins by name to work around mis-attribution.

non_goals: Do not auto-complete review_required_by_default tasks; the review gate stays authoritative.
Do not promote memory from failed or blocked tasks.
Do not replace harness_memory.db hybrid recall with a vector store in this contract's scope.

known_incident.summary: memory_promoted events stopped after 2026-06-03 while tasks kept being created; root surface was a shrinking share of auto-complete-eligible tasks plus a core-pipeline stop-propagation mis-attribution patched by a plugin-name special case in result_decorate/stage.py. The special case is removed and attribution is now per-handler state-flip based.
